title: Grasshopper And the String
statementMd:
One day, the Grasshopper was jumping on the lawn and found a piece of paper with a string. Grasshopper became interested what is the minimum *jump ability* he should have in order to be able to reach the far end of the string, jumping only on vowels of the English alphabet. *Jump ability* is the maximum possible length of his jump.

Formally, consider that at the begginning the Grasshopper is located directly in front of the leftmost character of the string. His goal is to reach the position right after the rightmost character of the string. In one jump the Grasshopper could jump to the right any distance from $1$ to the value of his *jump ability*.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c9bddfb78bb461141cbceccc6a5890fec0088928.png) The picture corresponds to the first example.

The following letters are vowels: '`A`', '`E`', '`I`', '`O`', '`U`' and '`Y`'.

## Input

The first line contains non-empty string consisting of capital English letters. It is guaranteed that the length of the string does not exceed 100.

## Output

Print single integer $*a*$ — the minimum *jump ability* of the Grasshopper (in the number of symbols) that is needed to overcome the given string, jumping only on vowels.
statementZhMd:
有一天，蚱蜢在草坪上跳跃时发现了一张写有字符串的纸。蚱蜢想知道，为了只跳到英文字母中的元音上并到达字符串的另一端，他至少需要具备多大的*跳跃能力*。*跳跃能力*是他一次跳跃所能达到的最大长度。

形式化地说，开始时蚱蜢位于字符串最左侧字符的正前方。他的目标是到达字符串最右侧字符之后的位置。蚱蜢每次可以向右跳跃任意长度，跳跃距离为 $1$ 到他的*跳跃能力*之间的整数。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c9bddfb78bb461141cbceccc6a5890fec0088928.png) 该图片对应第一个样例。

以下字母是元音：`A`、`E`、`I`、`O`、`U` 和 `Y`。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个非空字符串，由大写英文字母组成。保证字符串长度不超过 100。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数 $*a*$ — 蚱蜢只跳到元音上并越过给定字符串所需的最小*跳跃能力*（以字符数为单位）。
